comparison.objective: Zero an unpowered robot joint by aligning its link and inserting a calibration pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually hold a gravity-loaded link at its zero mark while inserting a pin through aligned holes.
comparison.success_condition: Pin is fully home, link remains within one degree of zero and still after release, with excessive link speed prohibited in relevant versions.
comparison.reason: This shares bimanual alignment and narrow insertion, but its tested outcome is load-supporting pin insertion. It has no controlled hammer strike, notch fracture, retained insert, or loose-fragment recovery.
